verdict.summary: The change correctly closes the durable Anthropic refresh-token exposure by refusing claude-credentials-json before worker-prep spools or materializes the credential, and independently refusing it at the launcher delivery seam. The codex pre-flight is tightened so every admitted path derives the mounted document and unconditionally checks the materialized file for the original refresh-token value. The added coverage is substantive: it checks refusal, operator-visible classification, absence of the sentinel across the entire prepared tree, absence of mount material, continued acceptance of the supported opaque Claude format, the dry-run strip-without-exchange path, and the launcher's exact non-dying format set. I found no correctness, fail-closed, test-vacuity, or security defect in the diff.
